subject: Activation readiness: Canary deployment, migration windows, and training plan (AcceleratorX)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@acceleratorx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Activation readiness: Canary deployment, migration windows, and training plan (AcceleratorX)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for signing. Attached is the proposed activation readiness playbook that I've embedded into our MAP for AcceleratorX (attached as acceleratorx_map_v1.pdf). High-level proposal below — this is intentionally staged to limit risk during the migration. Please review and confirm the blackout windows and attendee list for training.

Summary (timeline & phases)
- Canary: Oct 18–22 — 2% traffic to Redwood Dedicated pool in us-west1; we monitor latency, error rate, and model quality on the evaluation prompts.
- Staged migration (phase 1): Nov 1 — migrate 25% production traffic with automatic fallback to legacy model for 10 minutes on error spikes.
- Full cutover target: Nov 8 if phase 1 metrics pass acceptance criteria.
- Training: two 90-minute sessions week of Oct 25 (recorded).

Evaluation plan / acceptance criteria
- Functional: End-to-end prompts from your acceptance set (see sheet in runbook) — baseline pass rate >= 95% on domain intents.
- Performance: p95 latency < 350ms; token error rate (5xx/requests) < 0.2%.
- Cost delta: per-1k-token inference cost within agreed band (+/- 10%).

Operational items & owners (short)
- Canary monitoring: Rishi — dashboards, alerting thresholds, rollback automation.
- Runbook & cutover steps: Marissa — playbook owner and runbook author.
- Cutover coordination & comms: Grace — go/no-go and stakeholder updates.

Attachments: acceleratorx_map_v1.pdf (MAP with embedded timelines), acceleratorx_migration_runbook_v2.xlsx (initial runbook), training_deck_accx_v1.pptx (session deck).

Ask: Can you confirm the preferred migration blackout window (we proposed Nov 1 00:00–04:00 PT) and the list of internal engineers who will attend the training? Also let us know if you need SOC2 evidence before canary.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth launch.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the detailed plan and the attachments. A few quick notes from our side:

- Nov 1 00:00–04:00 PT is acceptable for the migration blackout window, but could we shift the canary window one day earlier (Oct 17–21)? Our internal compliance lead will be on PTO Oct 19 and we'd prefer canary to complete before then.
- We will require SOC2 artifact (Type II) shared prior to canary start — can you confirm where to upload?
- Training: we'll have three engineers plus our platform lead joining live. Please share calendar invites for two 90-minute sessions the week of Oct 25 (preferred dates Oct 26 and Oct 28 afternoons PT).

Tom (cc) will coordinate internal attendees and confirm any extra acceptance prompts we want staged into the evaluation set.

Best,
Samantha Lee
VP Product, AcceleratorX
Samantha@acceleratorx.com

Samantha —

Good notes, thanks. We can move the canary to Oct 17–21 to accommodate your compliance lead. Action items and updates below:

Updated plan highlights
- Canary: Oct 17–21 (2% traffic) — automated rollback policy engaged at 3 consecutive alert windows.
- Staged migration (phase 1): Nov 1 00:00–04:00 PT (25% traffic); phase 2 (75%) Nov 4–5; full cutover Nov 8 only if pass.

SOC2 evidence
- I'll upload SOC2 Type II to your secure S3 link (please confirm write access). Alternatively we can post to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bAccX-Implementation — let me know which you prefer.

Training schedule
- Proposed sessions: Oct 26 13:00–14:30 PT and Oct 28 13:00–14:30 PT. I'll send calendar invites after you confirm attendees.

Owner commitments (explicit)
- Grace: cutover comms, stakeholder approvals, go/no-go cadence.
- Marissa: runbook updates and dry-run checklist (complete by Oct 14). Attachment: acceleratorx_migration_runbook_v2.xlsx updated.
- Rishi: canary metric dashboard, alert thresholds, rollback automation tests (complete by Oct 15).
- Jordan: production networking and infra liaison (will schedule pre-cutover run).

Next steps
1) Samantha: confirm S3 vs Drive for SOC2 and share final training attendee list (by Oct 8).
2) Redwood: send training invites and updated runbook v2 by Oct 7.

I'll attach the updated runbook and the training deck in follow-up.

Thanks — Grace
